title: JSON Lines 流式处理与整体载入的对比
expected_output:
文件内容:
{"i": 0, "v": 0}
{"i": 1, "v": 1}
{"i": 2, "v": 4}

逐行解析条数 = 3
v 求和       = 5

若整体 json.load 多条记录:
  JSONDecodeError: Extra data | 行号 2

按 16 字节分块读取次数 = 4
文件字节数             = 54

要点: JSON Lines 可流式处理，内存占用与文件大小无关；整体 JSON 必须全量载入
code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("events.jsonl")
with open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for i in range(3):
        f.write(json.dumps({"i": i, "v": i * i}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

print("文件内容:")
print(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip("\n"))
print()

n = 0
total = 0
with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for line in f:
        rec = json.loads(line)
        n += 1
        total += rec["v"]
print("逐行解析条数 =", n)
print("v 求和       =", total)
print()

print("若整体 json.load 多条记录:")
try:
    json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
    print("  JSONDecodeError:", e.msg, "| 行号", e.lineno)
print()

with open(p, "rb") as f:
    chunks = 0
    while True:
        blk = f.read(16)
        if not blk:
            break
        chunks += 1
print("按 16 字节分块读取次数 =", chunks)
print("文件字节数             =", p.stat().st_size)
print()
print("要点: JSON Lines 可流式处理，内存占用与文件大小无关；整体 JSON 必须全量载入")
